description: Total Annual Water Production (Million Cubic Meters) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset provides information about the total annual potable water production in Qatar from desalination and RO plants, measured in million cubic meters, along with the annual growth rate. 2019-2025. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are water production, desalination, Growth. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
